eventTypes.description: Types of events to which the subscription will listen.

destinationUrl.description: URL to which webhooks will be posted. Must be HTTPS on an IANA-listed top-level domain name (e.g. .com) with a path (at least /). No query parameters, userinfo, non-443 ports, or fragments allowed. We do not treat this field as sensitive data, so do not use secrets in this URL such as tokens or API keys.

createdTime.description: Time when subscription was created (epoch milliseconds).

createdBy.description: Email address of the user who created the subscription.

status.description: Status of the subscription. Can be "active" or "inactive". The system may change the status to "inactive" in error scenarios.

lastUpdatedTime.description: Time when the subscription was last updated (epoch milliseconds).

lastUpdatedBy.description: Email address of the user who updated the subscription most recently.
